A.notes: Site A presents a clean, functional layout with nicely constructed CSS illustrations of the architecture. It lacks meaningful scroll-driven motion, relying mostly on standard document flow, but it executes the basic requirements flawlessly and passes all accessibility checks.

B.notes: Site B offers a more atmospheric and stylized approach, using a warm color palette and elegant, minimalist line-art for the room illustrations. However, it fails the color contrast hard gate, which zeros out its score.

raw.why: Site A wins by default because Site B fails a hard gate for color contrast, despite Site B having a slightly more atmospheric design.
